threads.body: The stated failure mode is inaccurate. Since `equalTo` also has an `equalTo(AttributeKey<Long>, int)` overload, the uncast conditional selects that overload; when the condition is false, Java unboxes the `null` branch and throws `NullPointerException` before the assertion runs. The mismatch with the `Long` key is not the observed failure.
